name: FluxTransit Profile screen
description: Design Graph of the FluxTransit Profile screen (OPUS card balance, saved routes, settings, app info), generated blind from XAML + MVUX model + style dictionary.

sourceSummary.label: Flux style dictionary (colors, brushes, typography, panel/button styles)

evidence.rationale: Page x:Class FluxTransit.Presentation.ProfilePage; ScrollViewer > StackPanel MaxWidth=600 Padding=16 Spacing=24 with SafeArea insets.
Two-column Grid at top of page: back button + title/subtitle stack.

properties.commandBehavior: Model GoBack awaits INavigator.GoBack(this) — navigates back with no fixed destination screen.

evidence.rationale: Button Command={Binding GoBack} with FluxIconButtonStyle; ProfileModel.GoBack calls _navigator.GoBack.
TextBlock Text="Profile" with FluxHeadingLarge style.
TextBlock literal beneath the page title.

Three sections share identical structure: Border with declared FluxGlassPanelStyle containing StackPanel Spacing=16 whose first child is an uppercase FluxMicro title. Clearly one reusable glass-panel section concept.
First glass-panel section, titled OPUS CARD; holds card visual, balance info, and update action.
Second glass-panel section, titled SAVED ROUTES; holds two route cards and an add-route button.
Third glass-panel section, titled SETTINGS; holds API key field, language chips, and alerts toggle.
Border 120x80 CornerRadius=12 with FluxPrimaryStrongBrush background; 'OPUS' literal plus TextBlock bound to CardNumber (model returns "**** 4521").
Literal label above the balance value.

properties.format: '$' literal Run followed by bound Run

evidence.rationale: TextBlock with Run Text={Binding OpusBalance}; model IState<decimal> defaults to 18.50m; FluxSuccessBrush foreground override.
Literal helper text under the balance value.

properties.behavior: Overlaid Grid swaps between the Update Balance button and a ProgressRing + 'Updating...' row via IsRefreshing visibility bindings.

evidence.rationale: Grid holding both presentations with opposite Visibility bindings on IsRefreshing (BoolToVisibilityConverter, ConverterParameter=Inverse on the button).

properties.commandBehavior: Model sets IsRefreshing=true, simulates a 1s refresh, sets a new OpusBalance, then IsRefreshing=false.

evidence.rationale: Button Command={Binding UpdateBalance}; ProfileModel.UpdateBalance implements the refresh.

properties.presentation: Update Balance button hidden; centered horizontal row with active 20x20 ProgressRing and 'Updating...' FluxBody text shown.

evidence.rationale: Opposite Visibility bindings on IsRefreshing drive the swap; IState<bool> IsRefreshing declared in the model (default false).

properties.backgroundOverride: Transparent (overrides FluxTransitCardStyle background on both instances)

evidence.rationale: Two structurally identical Borders (FluxTransitCardStyle, Background=Transparent, Padding=12) each with route icon, bold name, stops line, and trailing chevron — one reusable route-card concept.

unresolved.question: The 'Tap to refresh' hint implies tapping the balance area refreshes it, but no tap/click handler or command is attached to the balance info or card visual. Is the hint aspirational, or is the refresh only via the Update Balance button?
unresolved.reason: Text suggests an interaction the source does not wire up.

unresolved.question: Route cards show a trailing chevron (E76C), suggesting tap-to-open/navigate, but no Command, Click, or navigation attribute is declared on them. What happens when a route card is tapped?
unresolved.reason: Chevron affordance without any bound behavior.

unresolved.question: The two saved routes are hardcoded XAML literals rather than an items control bound to model data. Are they placeholders for a future bound collection?
unresolved.reason: ProfileModel exposes no routes collection; content is static.

unresolved.question: The 'Add New Route' button has no Command or Click handler. What action should it perform?
unresolved.reason: Control with no bound behavior; not inventing one.

unresolved.question: The language ChipGroup uses a literal IsChecked=True on the EN chip and is not bound, yet ProfileModel declares IState<string> SelectedLanguage (default "EN"). Is the selection meant to be two-way bound to SelectedLanguage?
unresolved.reason: Model state exists but XAML uses a static literal, not a binding.

unresolved.question: The Service Alerts ToggleSwitch uses a literal IsOn=True with no binding and no model state backs it. Does toggling it have any effect?
unresolved.reason: Control with a static literal value and no declared behavior.

unresolved.question: ProfileModel declares a SaveSettings command (reads GeminiApiKey and SelectedLanguage) but nothing on this screen binds to it. How are settings persisted or when is SaveSettings invoked?
unresolved.reason: Declared model command with no consumer in the page markup.

unresolved.question: FluxStyles.xaml declares FluxSpacingXS/S/M/L resources matching the literal 4/8/16/24 values used on this screen, but the XAML uses literals rather than the resources. Should the spacing tokens map to those declared resource keys?
unresolved.reason: Values coincide with declared resources but no consumption link exists in the page markup.

metadata.notes: Section titles and route-card internals are modeled as canonical-component properties per the v0.3 internals rule; the refreshing presentation (ProgressRing + 'Updating...') is described inside state.opus.refreshing rather than as separate nodes.
